name: Buffer
description: Manage Buffer (social media scheduling: organizations, channels, posts, ideas) from any AI agent via Buffer's GraphQL API. 9 tools, API key.
instructions:
This connector wraps Buffer's public GraphQL API at `https://api.buffer.com` (docs: https://developers.buffer.com). It replaces the legacy `api.bufferapp.com` REST API; Buffer's API is available on every plan, including Free.

**Setup**:
1. Sign in to Buffer and open **Settings → API** (https://publish.buffer.com/settings/api).
2. Click **Generate API Key** (Personal Access tab). Free accounts can hold one key, paid plans up to five.
3. Paste the key into `BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and acts as your own account: every organization and channel you can see in Buffer, with no per-organization scoping.

**Workflow**: everything hangs off an organization ID.
1. `buffer_current_user` — your account and its organizations (take the `id` of the one to work in).
2. `buffer_list_channels` — the connected social accounts of that organization (take a channel `id`).
3. `buffer_create_post` on one channel (call it once per channel to post the same text to several), or `buffer_create_idea` to park content at organization level.
4. `buffer_list_posts` / `buffer_list_ideas` to read them back, `buffer_update_post`, `buffer_send_now`, `buffer_delete_post` to change them.

**Scheduling (`mode`)**: `addToQueue` (next free slot of the channel's posting schedule, default), `shareNext` (top of the queue), `shareNow`, or `customScheduled` together with `due_at` (ISO 8601, UTC). `save_to_draft: true` stores a draft instead.

**Post status**: `draft`, `needs_approval`, `scheduled`, `sending`, `sent`, `error`.

**Errors**: mutations answer with a typed payload, not an HTTP error — a result carrying only `message` (e.g. `InvalidInputError`, `LimitReachedError`) means the change was refused; read the message. A 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` means the API key is missing, wrong or revoked.

**Media**: pass `assets` as a list where each entry holds exactly one of `image`, `video` or `document`, e.g. `[{"image": {"url": "https://…/photo.jpg"}}]`. Buffer does not host files: the URL must be publicly reachable.

**Network-specific options** (Instagram post/story/reel, Pinterest board, YouTube title, threads, first comments) go in `metadata`, keyed by network — see the PostInputMetaData reference at https://developers.buffer.com/reference.html.

**Rate limits** (per API key, rolling windows): 100 requests / 15 min on every plan; 250 / day on Free and Essentials, 500 on Team; 3,000–15,000 / 30 days depending on plan. A 429 carries `Retry-After` — wait that long instead of retrying.

**Beyond the typed tools**: `buffer_graphql_query` / `buffer_graphql_mutation` run any operation from the reference (tags, post metrics, content items). Buffer does not publish its schema without authentication, so `buffer_graphql_schema` cannot load it — use https://developers.buffer.com/reference.html instead.

tools.name: buffer_current_user
tools.description: Return the authenticated Buffer account (id, email, name, timezone) with the organizations it belongs to. Start here: every other tool needs an organization ID from this result.

endpointMapping.path: query Account { account { id email name timezone organizations { id name channelCount } } }

tools.name: buffer_list_channels
tools.description: List the connected social channels (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, …) of an organization, with their IDs, network, timezone and whether the queue is paused or the channel disconnected.

endpointMapping.path: query Channels($organizationId: OrganizationId!) { channels(input: { organizationId: $organizationId }) { id name displayName service descriptor timezone isQueuePaused isDisconnected isLocked } }

tools.name: buffer_list_posts
tools.description: List posts of an organization, newest page first, optionally filtered by channel IDs and status. Cursor-paginated: pass pageInfo.endCursor back as after.

channel_ids.description: Only posts on these channel IDs. Omit for every channel.

status.description: Only posts in these statuses, e.g. ["scheduled"]. Omit for all.

endpointMapping.path: query Posts($organizationId: OrganizationId!, $channelIds: [ChannelId!], $status: [PostStatus!], $first: Int = 20, $after: String) { posts(first: $first, after: $after, input: { organizationId: $organizationId, filter: { channelIds: $channelIds, status: $status } }) { edges { node { id status text dueAt sentAt createdAt channelId channelService shareMode externalLink error { message } } } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } } }

tools.name: buffer_create_post
tools.description: Create a post on ONE channel: add it to the queue, schedule it for a time, publish it now, or save it as a draft. To post the same content to several channels, call once per channel. Returns the post, or a message explaining why Buffer refused it.

mode.description: How to schedule: addToQueue (next free queue slot), shareNext (top of the queue), shareNow (publish immediately) or customScheduled (at due_at). Default addToQueue.

scheduling_type.description: automatic (Buffer publishes it, default) or notification (Buffer reminds you to publish it by hand, for networks or formats it cannot post directly).

due_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time, required with mode customScheduled (e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z).

save_to_draft.description: true saves a draft instead of scheduling it.

assets.description: Media to attach, in order. Each entry holds exactly one of image, video or document, e.g. [{"image": {"url": "https://example.com/photo.jpg"}}]. URLs must be publicly reachable.

metadata.description: Network-specific options keyed by network, e.g. {"instagram": {"type": "post", "shouldShareToFeed": true}}. See PostInputMetaData in the Buffer reference.

endpointMapping.path: mutation CreatePost($channelId: ChannelId!, $text: String, $mode: ShareMode! = addToQueue, $schedulingType: SchedulingType! = automatic, $dueAt: DateTime, $saveToDraft: Boolean, $assets: [AssetInput!], $tagIds: [TagId!], $metadata: PostInputMetaData) { createPost(input: { channelId: $channelId, text: $text, mode: $mode, schedulingType: $schedulingType, dueAt: $dueAt, saveToDraft: $saveToDraft, assets: $assets, tagIds: $tagIds, metadata: $metadata }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id status dueAt channelId text } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

tools.name: buffer_update_post
tools.description: Edit a post that has not been sent yet: text, schedule, media or tags. Only the fields you pass change; everything omitted is kept as it is.

post_id.description: Post ID, from buffer_list_posts or buffer_create_post.

mode.description: New scheduling: addToQueue (next free queue slot), shareNext (top of the queue), shareNow (publish immediately) or customScheduled (at due_at). Omit to keep the current schedule.

due_at.description: New ISO 8601 UTC time (with mode customScheduled).

save_to_draft.description: true turns the post back into a draft.

assets.description: Replaces the whole media list (same shape as in buffer_create_post); [] removes all media. Omit to keep it.

endpointMapping.path: mutation EditPost($id: PostId!, $text: String, $mode: ShareMode, $dueAt: DateTime, $saveToDraft: Boolean, $assets: [AssetInput!], $tagIds: [TagId!]) { editPost(input: { id: $id, text: $text, mode: $mode, dueAt: $dueAt, saveToDraft: $saveToDraft, assets: $assets, tagIds: $tagIds }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id status dueAt text } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

tools.name: buffer_delete_post
tools.description: Delete a post by ID. Posts that are publishing or already published may not be deletable; the result then carries a message instead of the deleted ID.

endpointMapping.path: mutation DeletePost($id: PostId!) { deletePost(input: { id: $id }) { ... on DeletePostSuccess { id } ... on MutationError { message } } }

tools.name: buffer_send_now
tools.description: Publish a queued or scheduled post immediately instead of at its slot. Buffer has no separate send-now call: this edits the post with mode shareNow and leaves everything else unchanged.

endpointMapping.path: mutation SendNow($id: PostId!) { editPost(input: { id: $id, mode: shareNow }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id status dueAt sentAt } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

tools.name: buffer_list_ideas
tools.description: List the ideas (content not yet assigned to a channel) of an organization. Cursor-paginated: pass pageInfo.endCursor back as after.

endpointMapping.path: query Ideas($organizationId: OrganizationId!, $first: Int = 20, $after: String) { ideas(first: $first, after: $after, input: { organizationId: $organizationId }) { edges { node { id content { title text services date } groupId createdAt updatedAt } } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } } }

tools.name: buffer_create_idea
tools.description: Save an idea in an organization: content you want to publish later, not yet tied to a channel or a time. Turn it into a post later with buffer_create_post.

endpointMapping.path: mutation CreateIdea($organizationId: ID!, $title: String, $text: String) { createIdea(input: { organizationId: $organizationId, content: { title: $title, text: $text } }) { ... on Idea { id content { title text } } ... on IdeaResponse { idea { id content { title text } } } ... on MutationError { message } } }
